handoff/carry policy on a transparent da.detail: Unresolved refusal (validity or owner undecided). The alias lists exactly u64's derived carry (suspension allowed, any CPU, any thread, movable), so it adds no demand. L3 publishes Copy and the four axes on Alias, with a separate normalized u64 target and no nominal Alias schema. The spec does not say whether a transparent alias may author a carry list that adds no demand, either equal to or weaker than its expansion's policy. The original case, which forbids suspension and pins the CPU on u64, is now refused in L3: a transparent alias cannot change its target's carry. The carry-free control lowers. Carry inherited through an alias from nominal data is not this case. Observed transparent alias carry policy requires a checked relation to its expansion at alias.omg in tests/declarations.rs::alias_with_carry_stops_at_its_attributes.
